ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) across the central and proximal regions, with high-intensity (white) pixel clusters localized to the distal tips, approximately an 85:15 ratio.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white blobs located on the distal margins of both lobes; the right lobe distal tip features a diffuse mottled white pattern extending inward, while the left lobe distal tip features a more concentrated white patch at the corner.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the lobe base.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across both lobes; left lobe exhibits several prominent jagged indentations (notches) midway; right lobe shows finer-grained irregular peaks and valleys concentrated toward the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge leading to an upward-swept, tapered distal point on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of circular white high-contrast spots present on the extreme distal tips and the lower leading edge of the right lobe, consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive detection of white, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) primarily on the right lobe, appearing as thin diagonal and horizontal scratches against the black background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular tissue loss or jagged indentations on the trailing edge of the left lobe; visible network of white scarring across the ventral surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct, thick linear white scar cluster located in the lower right quadrant of the right fluke lobe.
